Re: Appeal of denial of prior authorization  
Requested service: Partial knee replacement  
CPT: 27446  
Reference number: POC-332858B095-32885  
Plan: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina Commercial/ACA  

Dear Member Rights and Appeals:

I appeal the denial of prior authorization for CPT 27446, partial knee replacement. The denial states that the submitted imaging findings do not support medical necessity. The clinical record does support the requested procedure, and I ask Blue Cross NC to overturn the denial and authorize the surgery.

The June 2, 2026 MRI documents full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial compartment, with bone-on-bone apposition and Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 medial disease. These are advanced structural findings in the compartment being treated, rather than mild or nonspecific imaging abnormalities.

The imaging findings are consistent with substantial and persistent symptoms. I have experienced progressive knee pain for 24 months despite rest. The pain limits my daily function: I cannot climb stairs without assistance, and I wake three to four times each night because of pain. Examination also showed positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.

Nonoperative treatment has been attempted and has not provided adequate or lasting relief:

- I completed 20 supervised physical-therapy visits over 12 weeks, from April 8, 2026, through July 1, 2026, focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion.
- I used NSAIDs for eight months with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on April 6, 2026, provided only three weeks of partial relief.

The record also documents factors relevant to proceeding with surgery: there is no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI is 29, and I am a nonsmoker. Reyes, MD, orthopedic surgeon, submitted the request.

For these reasons, the MRI and the complete clinical record support medical necessity for partial knee replacement. Please conduct a full reconsideration using the MRI, physical-therapy discharge note, treatment history, examination findings, functional limitations, and the surgeon’s records.

The denial does not identify the specific medical policy, clinical review guideline, version, effective date, or imaging threshold applied to this request. I have not been provided the plan’s governing policy text, and the plan has not been quoted in this appeal. Please provide the exact criteria applied to CPT 27446 and identify any specific criterion that Blue Cross NC believes has not been met. Please also provide the clinical rationale and all records relied upon in making the denial.

Please reverse the denial and approve prior authorization for CPT 27446. If Blue Cross NC does not overturn the denial, please provide the complete written appeal determination, the specific criteria used, and information about any further review rights.

This appeal is being submitted within 180 days of the August 13, 2026 adverse benefit determination date and no later than February 9, 2027.

Sincerely,

Harper Delgado

Enclosures:

- June 2, 2026 MRI report
- Physical-therapy discharge note documenting treatment from April 8, 2026, through July 1, 2026
- Medication and injection history
- Orthopedic examination and clinical notes
- Surgeon’s prior-authorization request
- Copy of the adverse benefit determination
- Other supporting medical records
